# contentful_tag (Resource)

A Contentful tag groups and organizes entries and assets within an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_tag" "example" {
  space_id    = "space-id"
  environment = "master"

  id         = "campaign"
  name       = "Campaign"
  visibility = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) The ID of the environment
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the tag
- `name` (String) The human-readable unique name of the tag
- `space_id` (String) The ID of the space

### Optional

- `visibility` (String) The tag visibility: private tags are CMA-only; public tags are available through all Contentful APIs

### Read-Only

- `version` (Number) The current version of the tag
